topics.title: Before Your MRI: Implants, Devices, and What to Bring
topics.summary: If you have an implant or a medical device, the MRI team needs to know exactly what it is before your scan. Here is what to gather, what to tell them, and what to ask.

topics.title: MR Safety Basics
topics.summary: The core concepts of MR safety, using the definitions in the ACR Manual on MR Safety and FDA guidance.

topics.title: US MR Safety Certification: MRMD, MRSO, MRSE, and MRST
topics.summary: The International Board of Magnetic Resonance Safety (IBMRS) offers four MR safety credentials. Here is what each role does and how certification works, summarized from IBMRS's own pages.
